method: Actual STL XY sections with canonical edge interpolation and closed-loop assertions at 0.2mm pitch, z offset .071mm; morphological opening radius 0.4mm. Narrow tips and sharp corners also contribute.
judgment: Review fine roof/rim/corner regions and use supports where needed; no automatic printability claim.

accepted_exception.scope: Only these 44 cross-shaft/crossbar layers of this exact STL SHA; not a general relaxation or approval of rescaling.
accepted_exception.review: Specific exception approved after independent layer-localization and cross/root-ray review; support/removal and no-unreviewed-downscaling warnings required.
accepted_exception.limits: Not a full-direction minimum-wall test, slicer path test, or physical print guarantee.
